lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 8 distinct, high-contrast white vertical lines are visible on the lateral torso. Spacing is relatively uniform across the mid-section, with narrower gaps observed between the third and fourth lines from the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first and second posterior lines are composed of fragmented, dashed segments. The two anterior-most lines terminate prematurely, failing to reach the ventral fringe area.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 4 to 5 high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower posterior haunch, positioned dorsal to the hock joint.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two distinct spots on the mid-haunch are horizontally aligned, forming a short semi-connected geometric segment.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns follow a lyrate trajectory, arcing posteriorly from the frontal bone before curving dorsally and slightly medially towards the tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The estimated pixel distance between the terminal tips is approximately 1.8 times the combined width of the individual horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast light-colored (ivory) tipping accounts for approximately 10-15% of the total vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent dark ventral fringe extending from the sub-mandibular region to the abdomen; distinct white facial spots on the malar and sub-orbital regions; yellowish-tan lower limb coloration contrasting with the dark torso.
